lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns is visible on the lateral flank. The most posterior visible column features four large, distinct spots. Anterior to this, the spots become smaller and more densely packed.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance values on the dorsal side and shadow-based lower values on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A high concentration of small, elongated silhouettes representing commensal fish is visible clustered around the pectoral fin and the lower lateral flank.
